The fish exhibits a color pattern with a bright yellow anterior body (head and front) and a black posterior body (back and tail area). This is the inverse of the target class 'Rock Beauty' (Holocanthus tricolor), which typically has a black head and yellow tail. The background is a blurred blue aquatic environment.
